hooks.command: d="$(pwd)"; until [ -f "$d/.codex/hooks/fallow-gate.sh" ] || [ -e "$d/.git" ] || [ "$d" = / ]; do d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; if [ -f "$d/.codex/hooks/fallow-gate.sh" ]; then cd "$d" || exit 2; export TMPDIR="$d/temp/runtime" FALLOW_CACHE_DIR="$d/temp/cache/fallow" FALLOW_GATE_REPORT="$d/temp/work/fallow-gate/report.json"; mkdir -p "$TMPDIR" "$FALLOW_CACHE_DIR" "$(dirname "$FALLOW_GATE_REPORT")"; exec ./.codex/hooks/fallow-gate.sh; fi; exit 0
